about:
As a Front-End Developer, I have two years of modern web application development experience, and six years of professional work experience with Multi domain exposure. I specialize in developing responsive web interfaces using React, Javascript, Typescript, and Tailwind CSS along with other modern frontend technologies. 
 I am a self motivated individual who can work independently or as part of a team in building robust web applications with strong API integrations. Therefore, I have been focusing my efforts on more advanced solutions using MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js), which adds value and meaningfulness to the users.
